**Visual analysis:**

- **Plant part**: Sugarcane leaf (broad, elongated blade)
- **Pattern**: Fine, parallel yellowish-green streaks running along the length of the leaf, interspersed with darker green areas
- **Color**: Alternating light green/pale yellow streaks against a deeper green background — characteristic striping
- **Other features**: Small brown/reddish discoloration near what appears to be a leaf node junction; no distinct circular spots or blotches

**Reasoning through classes:**

- **Brown_Spot**: Would show discrete brown oval/circular lesions — absent here
- **Grassy_Shoot**: Affects plant architecture (excessive thin shoots), not leaf streaking
- **Leaf_Scald**: Produces pencil-line water-soaked lesions with cream/white margins — not this pattern
- **Pokkah_Boeng**: Chlorotic twisting/distortion at the base of young leaves — not present
- **Sett_Rot**: Underground sett/root rot — wouldn't manifest as leaf streaking
- **Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus**: Produces irregular, blocky mosaic patches of light/dark green — pattern here is more linear/streaked than patchy
- **Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv**: Produces fine, elongated streaks running parallel to veins — **matches the observed pattern**
- **Yellow_Leaf**: Pronounced yellowing of midrib and blade — overall leaf is still green here
- **Yellow_Spot**: Distinct yellow spots/lesions — not seen here

The fine parallel streaking along the leaf veins is the hallmark of Sugarcane Streak Mosaic Virus (SCSMV).
